beispiel: Nimm den Schirm mit, es regnet.

beispiel: Berlin ist die Hauptstadt von Deutschland.

beispiel: In unserer Firma stellen wir Möbel her.

beispielEn: I really like taking photos on vacation.

beispielEn: This plant needs a lot of water and light.

beispielEn: If you come, I'll bake a cake.

beispielTr: Bu ilacı günde üç kez alın!
beispielEn: Take this medication three times a day!

beispielEn: We buy the groceries at the supermarket.

beispielEn: Our two children are very different.

beispielEn: Shall we go to the exhibition together tomorrow?

beispielEn: I write all my appointments in my calendar.

beispielEn: If I have a good report card, I'll get a scholarship.

beispielEn: You can get the form at the town hall.

beispielEn: My wife and I do the housework together.

beispielEn: Steffi plays tennis very well.

beispielEn: After the meal I wash the dishes.

beispielEn: The landscape here is really beautiful.

beispielEn: On Saturday we have an event at the restaurant.

beispielEn: The move to the new apartment was exhausting.

beispielEn: Could you translate the letter for me, please?

beispielEn: Do you play an instrument too?

beispielEn: I'm unpacking the new shoes right away.

beispielEn: The heating is broken and it's cold.
